name: Feature Lifecycle — Rate Limiter with Config, Tests & Docs
description: Implement RateLimiter class, wire into AppConfig, author documentation in docs/RATE_LIMITING.md, and ensure tests pass.

inputs.task_prompt: Add a rate limiting feature to the project: 1) Update AppConfig in src/config.ts with rateLimit config { maxRequests: number, windowMs: number } defaulting to { maxRequests: 5, windowMs: 1000 }. 2) Implement RateLimiter class in src/limiter.ts with isAllowed(ip: string): boolean and reset(): void. 3) Document configuration and usage in docs/RATE_LIMITING.md. 4) Ensure all tests in test/limiter.test.ts pass.

acceptance_criteria: src/config.ts exports defaultConfig with rateLimit settings
src/limiter.ts exports RateLimiter class implementing isAllowed and reset
docs/RATE_LIMITING.md exists and documents configuration options and usage
constraints: RateLimiter must track requests per IP within the configured sliding/fixed window
reset() must clear all tracked IP request history
